title: Generic boss
text: Each preset against a level 63 boss with no creature type. In client 70425 no racial depends on the weapon.

title: Beast target
text: A Beast boss turns on Troll Beast Slaying and Dwarf Big Game Hunter (5% more damage).

title: Elemental target
text: An Elemental boss turns on High Order and Windshaper Elemental Insight (5% more damage).

title: Humanoid target
text: Priests only. Dwarf Priests cast Chastise, which works only on Humanoids. No other racial cares about Humanoids.

title: Racials off
text: Every race on its base stats, with all racials left out.

title: The Human Spirit
text: Spirit increased by 5%.
short: Spirit increased by 5%.

title: Ruthless
text: +2% critical strike chance with all spells and attacks, with any weapon.
short: +2% critical strike chance with all spells and attacks, with any weapon.

title: Earth Fury
text: Critical strike bonus to damage and healing increased by 2%.
short: Critical strike bonus to damage and healing increased by 2%.

title: Savage
text: +1% critical strike chance with all spells and abilities, with any weapon.
short: +1% critical strike chance with all spells and abilities, with any weapon.

title: Elune's Light
text: +10% critical strike chance for 15s, 3 min cooldown.
short: +10% critical strike chance for 15s, 3 min cooldown.

title: Shadowmeld
text: Slip into the shadows, 2 min cooldown in combat. The next stealth ability (Ravage, Ambush, Garrote) can follow it.
short: Slip into the shadows, 2 min cooldown in combat. The next stealth ability (Ravage, Ambush, Garrote) can follow it.

title: Read Leyline
text: A 2s cast that doubles health and mana regeneration for 30s away from a leyline, 2 min cooldown.
short: A 2s cast that doubles health and mana regeneration for 30s away from a leyline, 2 min cooldown.

title: Expansive Mind
text: Maximum Mana, Rage or Energy increased by 5%.
short: Maximum Mana, Rage or Energy increased by 5%.

title: Eureka!
text: For 8s, direct damage abilities cost 10% less and deal 10% more damage (DoTs too for Warlocks, heals too for Priests), 2 min cooldown.
short: For 8s, direct damage abilities cost 10% less and deal 10% more damage (DoTs too for Warlocks, heals too for Priests), 2 min cooldown.

title: Blood Fury
text: Attack power and spell power increased by 10% for 15s, 3 min cooldown.
short: Attack power and spell power increased by 10% for 15s, 3 min cooldown.

title: Touch of the Grave
text: Spells and attacks have a 20% chance (30% for Mages, Priests and Warlocks) to deal Shadow damage equal to 5% of your maximum health and heal you for it. At most once every 25s, and it cannot crit.
short: 20% chance a hit (30% for Mages, Priests and Warlocks) to deal Shadow damage equal to 5% of max health. At most once every 25s.

title: Endurance
text: Health increased by 5% and critical strike bonus to damage and healing increased by 2%.
short: Health increased by 5% and critical strike bonus to damage and healing increased by 2%.

title: Berserking
text: Attack and casting speed increased by 10% for 10s, 3 min cooldown.
short: Attack and casting speed increased by 10% for 10s, 3 min cooldown.

title: Wind Blessed
text: Spellcasting, melee and ranged haste increased by 3%.
short: Spellcasting, melee and ranged haste increased by 3%.

title: Big Game Hunter
text: Damage dealt versus Beasts increased by 5%.
short: Damage dealt versus Beasts increased by 5%.

title: Beast Slaying
text: Damage dealt versus Beasts increased by 5%.
short: Damage dealt versus Beasts increased by 5%.

title: Elemental Insight
text: Damage dealt versus Elementals increased by 5%.
short: Damage dealt versus Elementals increased by 5%.

title: Chastise
text: Dwarf Priests: an instant Holy hit on a Humanoid, 2 min cooldown.
short: Dwarf Priests: an instant Holy hit on a Humanoid, 2 min cooldown.

title: Starshards
text: Night Elf Priests: Arcane damage over 6s, 30s cooldown.
short: Night Elf Priests: Arcane damage over 6s, 30s cooldown.

title: Dark Sacrifice
text: Undead Priests: trade health for mana over 15s, 10 min cooldown.
short: Undead Priests: trade health for mana over 15s, 10 min cooldown.

title: Base stats
text: The race's own stats, with no racials.
short: The race's own stats, with no racials.

title: Target type
text: Racials, talents and spells that work only on this creature type.
short: Racials, talents and spells that work only on this creature type.

title: Warrior
text: Orc is best on every Warrior preset. Human is next, 0.0% behind on Fury. Human Ruthless is the biggest racial on Fury, +21.4 DPS (2.2%). Against Beasts, Dwarf leads Fury (+5.0% vs the generic boss), 0.5% ahead of Troll. Against Elementals, High Order and Windshaper lead Fury (+5.0% vs the generic boss), 4.3% ahead of Orc.

title: Rogue
text: High Order is best on Combat Daggers and Combat Swords. Orc is best on Seal Fate Daggers, Mutilate and Subtlety. Human is best on Seal Fate Swords. High Order Wind Blessed is the biggest racial on Combat Daggers, +13.4 DPS (1.7%). Against Beasts, Dwarf leads Combat Daggers (+5.0% vs the generic boss), 0.7% ahead of Troll.

title: Hunter
text: Human is best on every Hunter preset. Orc is next, 0.4% behind on Beast Mastery. Human Ruthless is the biggest racial on Beast Mastery, +19.3 DPS (1.7%). Against Beasts, Dwarf leads Beast Mastery (+3.6% vs the generic boss), 0.3% ahead of Troll. Against Elementals, High Order and Windshaper lead Beast Mastery (+3.6% vs the generic boss), 3.0% ahead of Human.

title: Paladin
text: Human is best on every Paladin preset. Undead is next, 0.6% behind on Ret sub-Holy. Human Ruthless is the biggest racial on Ret sub-Holy, +14.7 DPS (1.5%). Against Beasts, Dwarf leads Ret sub-Holy (+4.8% vs the generic boss), 3.8% ahead of Human.

title: Shaman
text: Orc is best on Enhancement, Enh Imp GW, Enh Water Shield and Enh Mana Tide. Windshaper is best on Elemental and Elemental Mana Tide. The best Alliance race on Enhancement is Dwarf, 0.9% behind. Windshaper Wind Blessed is the biggest racial on Enhancement, +13.7 DPS (1.5%). Against Beasts, Dwarf leads Enhancement (+5.0% vs the generic boss), 0.3% ahead of Troll. Against Elementals, Windshaper leads Enhancement (+5.0% vs the generic boss), 4.7% ahead of Orc.

title: Druid
text: Night Elf is best on Feral. Tauren is best on Balance. High Order is best on Balance Wrath. Night Elf Shadowmeld is the biggest racial on Feral, +13.4 DPS (1.6%). Against Elementals, High Order and Windshaper lead Feral (+5.0% vs the generic boss), 3.6% ahead of Night Elf.

title: Mage
text: Human is best on Fire, Frostfire and Arcane. High Order is best on Frost. Human Ruthless is the biggest racial on Fire, +19.3 DPS (1.8%). High Order Wind Blessed costs 9.8 DPS on Frostfire. Against Beasts, Troll leads Fire (+5.0% vs the generic boss), 3.0% ahead of Human. Against Elementals, High Order leads Fire (+5.0% vs the generic boss), 2.5% ahead of Human.

title: Warlock
text: Human is best on every Warlock preset. Orc is next, 0.6% behind on Demonology. Human Ruthless is the biggest racial on Demonology, +19.7 DPS (1.9%). Against Beasts, Troll leads Demonology (+4.6% vs the generic boss), 2.9% ahead of Human.

title: Priest
text: Human is best on Shadow and Shadow + Holy. Undead is best on Smite. The best Horde race on Shadow is Troll, 0.8% behind. Human Ruthless is the biggest racial on Shadow, +15.4 DPS (1.6%). Against Beasts, Dwarf leads Shadow (+5.0% vs the generic boss), 0.2% ahead of Troll.
